request.state:
Icelandic original: „Grábrók, mikið hlegið af nafninu og fyrsta stopp þegar fjölskyldan lagði af stað í hringferð um landið þar sem hver staður var öðrum fallegri, fossar, vötn og lækir, íslensku jurtirnar okkar, bláber, krækiber og hundasúrur um allt land, ferskt og ískalt vatn og heitt vatn, náttúrulaugar og fallegir baðstaðir út um allt land, ferskt loft, vera með fjölskyldunni í undurfagri náttúru út um allt land, kyrðin, góður matur og ........“
English gloss: “Grábrók, much loved by its name and the first stop when the family set out on a tour of the country where each place was more beautiful than the last, waterfalls, lakes and streams, our Icelandic herbs, blueberries, cranberries and wild strawberries across the entire land, fresh and cold water and hot water, natural hot springs and beautiful bathing spots throughout the entire land, fresh air, being with the family in wonderfully beautiful nature throughout the entire land, sheep, good food and ........”

faithful.instructions: Is the English gloss a faithful translation of the Icelandic original, with no added or missing meaning?
